name: metamask
onboarding: Click 'Create a new wallet' (or 'Import'), set a password, skip the secret-recovery-phrase backup if just probing. Decline the optional metrics opt-in prompt to test the baseline; run a second pass accepting it to compare.
notes: MetaMask is known to use Segment (analytics) and Sentry (crash). Those should surface as third-party. Infura is its default RPC (Consensys-owned) — treated first-party here.
